name: @activepieces/piece-runway
description: AI-powered content generation platform for creating high-quality images and videos using text prompts

auth.description: Your Runway API key. Get it from your Runway account settings.

generate_image_from_text.name: generate_image_from_text
generate_image_from_text.description: Generates an image using a text prompt via Runway's AI models

model.description: AI model to use for image generation

promptText.description: Describe what you want to see in the image (max 1000 characters)

referenceImages.description: Up to 3 reference images (required for gen4_image_turbo)

uri.description: HTTPS URL or data URI of the reference image

tag.description: Name to reference this image in your prompt using @tag (3-16 characters, alphanumeric + underscore)

publicFigureThreshold.description: How strict content moderation should be for recognizable public figures

aiMetadata.description: Submits a text-to-image generation job to Runway and returns the created task ID; the image is produced asynchronously, so poll Get Task Details with that ID to retrieve the result. Choose when an agent needs to create an image from a prompt. Each call starts a new billable generation, so it is not idempotent; the gen4_image_turbo model requires at least one reference image.

generate_video_from_image.name: generate_video_from_image
generate_video_from_image.description: Generates a video based on image(s) and text prompt using Runway's AI models

model.description: AI model to use for video generation

promptImageFile.description: Upload an image file to use as the video's starting frame

promptImageUrl.description: HTTPS URL of an image to use as the video's starting frame

imagePosition.description: Position of the image in the video (last frame only supported by gen3a_turbo)

promptText.description: Describe what should happen in the video (max 1000 characters)

auth.description: Your Runway API key. Get it from your Runway account settings.

ratio.description: Available resolutions depend on the selected model

auth.description: Your Runway API key. Get it from your Runway account settings.

duration.description: Available durations depend on the selected model

auth.description: Your Runway API key. Get it from your Runway account settings.

contentModeration.description: Content moderation settings (not available for veo3)

aiMetadata.description: Submits an image-to-video generation job to Runway from a starting frame and optional prompt, returning the created task ID; the video is produced asynchronously, so poll Get Task Details with that ID for the result. Provide the starting frame as exactly one of an uploaded file or an HTTPS image URL (not both). Choose when an agent needs to animate an image into a clip. Each call starts a new billable generation, so it is not idempotent.

get_task_details.name: get_task_details
get_task_details.description: Retrieve details of an existing Runway task by its ID

taskId.description: The unique ID of the task to retrieve (UUID format)

downloadOutput.description: Download and return the generated files as attachments (if task succeeded)

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a Runway generation task by its ID and returns its current status, progress, and output URLs; optionally downloads the generated files as attachments when the task has succeeded. Use to poll the result of an image or video generation started by the generate actions. Read-only and idempotent; requires a valid task UUID.

cancel_or_delete_task.name: cancel_or_delete_task
cancel_or_delete_task.description: Cancel or delete a task. Running/pending tasks are cancelled, completed tasks are deleted.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to cancel or delete (UUID format)

aiMetadata.description: Aborts or removes a Runway task by ID: a running, pending, or throttled task is cancelled, while an already-completed task is deleted. Use when an agent needs to stop a generation in progress or clean up a finished task. Mutating and not idempotent (a repeat call on an already-removed task reports it as already deleted); requires a valid task UUID.
